name: fire_under_mech
question: When does a mech on a burning tile catch fire? (Mission_BurnbugBoss recordings: mechs on burning tiles stayed unburnt.)
mission: any mission without an environment, player turn 1-3, not the last turn
observe: After SCENARIO: mech 0 at (3,3) stood still while its tile caught fire (Board:SetTerrain TERRAIN_FIRE): on fire or not?
Mech 1 was put on the already burning (5,3) with SetSpace: on fire or not?
Mech 2 walks (1,5) -> (1,3) onto fire with MOVE_NATIVE (the Move skill): on fire on arrival?
After End Turn: each burning mech loses 1 HP in the fire tick; compare with the engine.
